testcase.system-out: Scenario: Maximize and restores the Open dialog ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software as a restored window ✔ And a saved part with a preview is selected ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected with its name and preview ✔ When the user maximizes the Open dialog ✔ Then the dialog expands to fill the available screen ✔ And the file list, navigation pane, preview and bottom actions remain visible ✔ And the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed ✔ When the user restores the Open dialog ✔ Then it returns to its previous window size and position ✔ And the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed
